purpose: Teach: 書き込ま/予告編/エンターテインメント/ニックネーム/イコール/号機/点灯/アース
target_vocab: エンターテインメント

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、調書に丁寧に書き込まれますね
lines.en: The police write everything down carefully in their statements.
lines.style: Observational, matter-of-fact. Even pace. Slight nod of acknowledgment in the delivery, as if noting something sensible that happens routinely.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯活動の予告編的告知もされますね
lines.en: The police also issue advance notices about their crime-prevention activities.
lines.style: Same measured tone. A tick lighter — this is expected procedure. No surprise in the voice, just noting what happens.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民向けエンターテインメント要素のある安全教室も開かれますね
lines.en: The police run safety classes with educational entertainment elements for the community too.
lines.style: Slight warmth here — acknowledging the civic effort. Still conversational, unhurried. A small nod of approval without overselling it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者のニックネームも調書に記録されますね
lines.en: They even record suspects' nicknames in the official statements.
lines.style: Gentle smile in the voice. This detail amuses him slightly without mocking. Still easy, still observant — just noting something that humanises the process.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現行犯と既決犯はイコールではないと区別されますね
lines.en: The police distinguish between arrests in the act and prior convictions — they're not the same.
lines.style: More deliberate now. A hint of gravitas. Speaking with precision about something that matters legally. Lean in slightly on the distinction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、無線機の一号機から順に点検されますね
lines.en: They go through their radio units one by one from the first one onward, checking everything.
lines.style: Procedural, steady. A note of respect for the thoroughness. Not rushed. Matter-of-fact about the routine rigour.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署の防犯灯の点灯確認もされますね
lines.en: They also verify that all the crime-prevention lights around the station are on.
lines.style: Back to easy observation. A small practical detail. Quiet satisfaction in the delivery — this is how things get done properly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、電子機器のアース工事も依頼されますね
lines.en: And they arrange for grounding work on their electronic equipment.
lines.style: Finishing note. Slightly quieter, almost administrative. The last item on a list. No fanfare, just closure.
